pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with highly irregular, serrated boundaries. Edges exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions with frequent angular, leaf-like projections into the light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junctions primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way nodes with variable pixel thickness that narrows at intersection points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane forming a continuous 1D geometric contour along the upper neck and shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism perched on the dorsal ridge near the transition between the upper neck and shoulder.
